field_evidence.ppd_scope: HM Land Registry states that Price Paid Data contains property-sale records for England and Wales that are sold for value and lodged for registration.
field_evidence.linked_data_channel: HM Land Registry publishes Price Paid Data as machine-readable linked data and documents linked-data access alongside bulk downloads.
field_evidence.target_window: Unused REST/JSON transaction-record window constrained to propertyAddress.postcode=TN25 7JX, _pageSize=50 and descending transaction date.
field_evidence.transport_result: The exact target REST/JSON URL could not be retrieved through the available web transport, so no target transaction payload or transaction unique identifier was obtained in this batch.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: Price Paid Data is transaction/address data. Even a returned Forge Cottage transaction would not itself supply an authoritative registered-title/index-polygon geometry or canonical parcel bbox.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted. Any transaction-to-title/INSPIRE binding and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. An unused official HM Land Registry Price Paid linked-data REST/JSON window was constrained to TN25 7JX with a maximum page size of 50, but the exact target endpoint could not be retrieved through this transport and therefore no Forge Cottage transaction identifier was obtained. Price Paid Data also does not itself provide registered-title/index-polygon geometry or a canonical parcel bbox. Local OpenCode or another authoritative target-specific workflow must bind the exact registered-title/title-boundary polygon; after canonical bbox is bound, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from HM Land Registry Local Land Charges GML source-area inventory to HM Land Registry Price Paid linked-data REST/JSON target-postcode retrieval. The public no-login endpoint is a distinct access route from the prior SPARQL and yearly-CSV attempts, but the exact TN25 7JX request was unavailable through this transport, so no transaction record can be asserted here. Even if a transaction were returned, PPD is not cadastral/title-boundary geometry. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
